headline: Bitcoin surges past $85.5k, targeting key resistance as bullish expansion fuels liquidity hunt
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC holds a higher‑high/higher‑low structure, bouncing off the 84,950 $ support zone; the 4H shows a clean uptrend with the next liquidity pool forming near 86,200 $ resistance.
altcoin_summary: Alt‑coin capital is rotating into high‑momentum assets, with KERNEL, ONE and FORM leading the rally, indicating a short‑term risk‑on bias beyond Bitcoin.
strategy_outlook: Spot: add on pull‑backs to ~84,950 $ with stops at 84,400 $; Futures: go long on a clean break above 86,200 $ with a 2:1 reward‑to‑risk target around 88,500 $.
